comments.body:
👦🏽: Anyone else feel like their study materials multiply when they’re not looking?

🤔 : If I start talking to my textbooks, does that count as study group interaction?

👮‍♂️ 
Hello fellow studis
I need some cosmic dust to get through these late-night study sessions. Who’s got the good stuff? 
 
👧 Hey, quick question—does anyone know if the library allows inflatable furniture? I’m thinking of bringing a beanbag.

👮🏻
I need some neural network nuggets to keep me engaged through this lecture. Who’s got the algorithmic herb?”
